stem: A contractor at Bramwell Systems clones an existing Terraform repository onto a new laptop and runs `terraform plan`, but Terraform reports that no provider plugins are installed. What should they run first?
rationale: Init is the first command to run after cloning a configuration, and it is what installs provider plugins. fmt only rewrites style and installs nothing. validate needs plugins already installed to check attribute names and types, so it would fail the same way plan did. destroy deprovisions managed objects and has no role in installing anything.
